title: Soluners Currency Datapack
description: A datapack that adds tradable currency to minecraft using Items
body:
# Soluner's Currency Datapack
A datapack I made for a currency that can be edited in a scoreboard

## What does it add?


### Fully useable scoreboard
You can edit and change the amount of money a player may have at any point.
There is a total of 3 scoreboards that is used in the Datapack:
- 1. The money score
- 2. The triggers for players
- 3. A failsafe to save data

### Text based UI for players
In the players or users eyes, the UI is all text based and easy to use.
You can also do the trigger commands but you may need to look at the datapack before doing so.

### Customs Items
The datapack adds 1 new item, A wallet.
The wallet can be crafted using a paper, 7 leather and a iron ingot
Holding the item will give a actionbar title to display the UI
